dof_d02.finding: AE does blur at aperture 80, but only by a few pixels. Soft alpha edge widths on row 150 are: in-focus layer z0_d1000 0 px (sharp); z500 layers 3 px; zm300_d700 4 px; z1000_d2000 5 px. At aperture 400 the same edges are 14-22 px. So the blur is real but small at a80; look at the alpha channel, since the PNGs have a transparent background and the RGB edges look hard.
